origine_fr: En bas, 辶, la marche ; dessus, 弟, qui donne le son (dì). C'est se relayer. Ce qui passe de main en main : transmettre, tendre.
origine_en: Below, 辶, walking; on it, 弟, which gives the sound (dì). It means taking turns, like relays. What passes from hand to hand: to pass on, to hand over.

phrase.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shū dì gěi wǒ.
phrase.fr: Passe-moi le livre, s'il te plaît.
